title: Got Questions? We Have Answers.
subtitle: Clear responses to our most common product and shipping questions.

faqs.question: What are your shipping options and delivery timelines?
faqs.answer: We offer Standard Shipping (3–5 business days) and Express Courier (1–2 business days). Orders over $75 qualify for complimentary standard shipping worldwide. You will receive real-time carrier tracking upon dispatch.

faqs.question: What is your return and exchange policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return window for unworn and unused products in their original packaging. Prepaid digital return labels are provided through our automated self-serve return portal.

faqs.question: How can I track my order once it has shipped?
faqs.answer: Once your package leaves our fulfillment center, you will immediately receive an email and SMS confirmation containing your tracking number and a live carrier status link.

faqs.question: What payment methods and currencies do you accept?
faqs.answer: We support Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, and interest-free installment plans via Klarna. Currencies are automatically converted based on your checkout locale.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally to countries outside the US?
faqs.answer: Yes, we ship to over 65 countries worldwide. International shipping options, duties, and local taxes are calculated with transparent upfront pricing at checkout.

faqs.question: Are your materials sustainably and ethically sourced?
faqs.answer: Every item in our collection is crafted with certified ethical manufacturing standards, recycled packaging, and responsibly sourced materials designed for long-lasting durability.

faqs.question: Can I cancel or modify my order after placing it?
faqs.answer: Orders are processed rapidly to ensure quick delivery. If you need to make changes or cancel, please contact customer care within 60 minutes of placing your order.

faqs.question: What warranty or guarantee comes with purchases?
faqs.answer: All premium hardware, watches, tech gear, and leather essentials include a complimentary 1-year manufacturer guarantee protecting against defects in workmanship.

faqs.question: Do you offer wholesale, bulk orders, or corporate gifting?
faqs.answer: Yes! For orders of 15 units or more, or bespoke corporate gifting packages, our sales concierge provides tiered pricing and custom packaging options.

faqs.question: How do I contact customer support if I need assistance?
faqs.answer: Our dedicated support team is available Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 6 PM EST via live concierge chat or email. Typical response time is under two hours.
